title: The $5 Aldi Find That Makes Meal Prep Effortless - NewsBreak
text: As much as we hate to admit it, meal prepping makes getting dinner on the table in under 20 minutes a non-issue. It’s the ultimate hack to effectively eliminate the excuse of time during the week and makes bringing your own lunch to work an actual possibility. Sure, you might have to take the time out of your weekend actually to cook something, but future you will be so glad you did. 😋😋 SIGN UP to get delicious recipes, handy kitchen hacks & more in our daily Pop Kitchen newsletter 🍳 🍔 You can make wraps and quiches, overnight oats , or something simple like a salad , and perfectly portion everything out for a quick and easy grab-and-go meal. In essence, it’s fool-proof. Beyond just having the recipes, though, meal prepping requires a few essential pieces of equipment, and we’re not talking about an immersion blender . You won’t necessarily need to go out and stock your kitchen with specialty items like a burger press or a sous vide machine, but you will need a collection of storage containers in a variety of shapes and sizes. Related: This Innovative $5 Find from Aldi Promises Perfect Pasta Without the Mess Not only do they make it easy to just grab your lunch and head out the door, but they might even make getting into the swing of meal prepping more effortless and fun. These vibrant ones from Aldi, for example, are the space-saving, portion-perfect meal prep solution you didn’t know you needed. The wallet-friendly retailer just brought back its fan-favorite Corfton Portion Perfect Collapsible Meal Kit in three and four-compartment styles, and we’ll definitely be stocking up. These meal prep must-haves come in navy, pink, and gray colorways and feature an included lid, making them stackable for all your weekly meals. Each container is made of silicone and collapses flat when not in use, so they won’t take up any extra space in your cabinet. The perfectly portioned compartments are great for everything from protein to sides, and the bases are microwave safe to make reheating your lunch effortless. Whether you’re a college student headed back to school or a busy adult looking to stay on top of your fitness goals, these must-have storage containers are a steal at just $5.
